title: Stage 1B Comprehensive Multi-Team Adversarial Analysis & Updated Roadmap

teamAssignments.name: UX, Accessibility, Visual Craft & Spec Fidelity

roleReviews.roleTitle: Team Alpha: Security, Concurrency & Storage Integrity (with storage-csp-auditor)

findings.title: Unbounded persistent GM_setValue alt_title:* / draft:* / response_ratings keys + cache_index overshoot risk
findings.resolution: Documented in comprehensive audit & scheduled for bounded persistent alt_title_index LRU (500 keys) and atomic cache eviction cleanup in Stage 2.

findings.title: Direct innerHTML='' assignment on ttsRateBtn (line 6078) violates YouTube strict Trusted Types CSP
findings.resolution: Pinpointed exact line 6078 and scheduled replacement with clearEl() plus automated CI sink check in Stage 2.

findings.title: Empty-transcript alt-title fallback can cache originalTitle inside setCachedAltTitle() (lines 8710-8723)
findings.resolution: Root-caused in generateAlternativeTitle() and scheduled no-cache guard in Stage 1.

roadmapReview.notes: Expanded Stages 1-5 prioritize CSP Trusted Types safety, bounded persistent storage, and async fault-injection coverage ahead of feature expansion.

roleReviews.roleTitle: Team Beta: Systems Reliability, DOM Lifecycle & Performance (with spa-observer-profiler)

findings.title: Whole-body characterData MutationObserver on document.body (line 9134) triggers scans during player time ticks
findings.resolution: Profiled root cause and scheduled mutation target filtering + player exclusion in Stage 2.

findings.title: SPA recycled feed cards skip re-processing via WeakSet without checking changed videoId; /shorts/ URLs unsupported
findings.resolution: Scheduled dataset.ytaisVideoId drift check & /shorts/ matcher in Stage 2.

findings.title: 1s global heartbeat setInterval writes GM_setValue 5x more frequently than CONFIG.heartbeatMs (5000ms)
findings.resolution: Scheduled heartbeat commit interval throttle (5000ms) and Stage 1 Ask fault-injection tests (AUD-09).

roadmapReview.notes: Stage 1 Ask ladder fault-injection and Stage 2 observer/SPA lifecycle hardening systematically eliminate runtime overhead and hidden race vectors.

roleReviews.roleTitle: Team Gamma & Delta: UX, A11y, Architecture & Feature R&D (with a11y-parity-skeptic & feature-rnd-challenger)

findings.title: Resize handle mousedown listeners omitted from _interactionCleanup; missing north resize & keyboard separator nav
findings.resolution: Scheduled in Stage 3 alongside ARIA live regions, non-blocking shadow toasts replacing window.alert(), and integrated Simulator Playwright suite.

findings.title: Dual-codebase logic drift (12.1k userscript vs 4.2k App.tsx / helpers) and global simulator ttsToast collision
findings.resolution: Per-window simulator toast isolation scheduled in Stage 1; full App.tsx decomposition + zero-drift shared core + FEAT-01/02/03 scheduled in Stage 4.

findings.title: High-value feature roadmap validated: Timestamp Jump-Sync, Channel Alt-Title Rules, Summary Personas, Chapter Chunking, Markdown Bundle
findings.resolution: All researched enhancements and 6 new features sequenced into Stages 3-5 with clear acceptance criteria.

roadmapReview.notes: Updated 5-stage roadmap balances reliability/security debt burn-down cleanly before modular refactoring and high-value UX features.
